description: Transform a nested JSON API response into a flattened CSV file. Input file is located at '/home/ga/workspace/data/api_response.json' containing 50 user records with nested 'profile' objects and 'tags' arrays. Create output file '/home/ga/workspace/data/users_export.csv' with exactly these headers (comma-separated, no spaces): 'User ID,Username,Email,Department,Level,Last Login Date,Status,Tags'. Apply these transformations: (1) Extract nested 'profile.department' to 'Department' column and 'profile.level' to 'Level' column, (2) Convert 'last_login' ISO timestamp (e.g., '2024-01-15T14:23:45Z') to date-only format 'YYYY-MM-DD' (e.g., '2024-01-15'), or 'N/A' if null, (3) Convert 'tags' array to comma-space separated string (e.g., ['premium', 'verified'] becomes 'premium, verified'), (4) Map columns: id→User ID, user_name→Username, user_email→Email, status→Status. The output CSV must have exactly 51 lines (1 header + 50 data rows). Use any method: Python/Node.js script, VSCode extensions, manual editing, or command-line tools.

metadata.real_world_scenario: Converting API responses for stakeholder analysis in Excel
